svg.title: bubble gum: scent arrives first; the heart drifts farther
svg.desc: philia's korean and english lyric scrapbook for newjeans' bubble gum. pale yellow-green paper, coral handwriting and bubbles surround three original mv stills of a palm-tree close-up, flowers beside a face, and two figures at the sea. lyric notes connect anticipation, scent, memory and floating farther away.

text.tspan: scent arrives first; the heart drifts farther.

g.aria-label: open a moment held in scent

text.tspan: why it took so long today.
i'm always so excited to meet you

g.aria-label: explore my scent finds you first
